description: Classification of all 831 FIRE checklist items by distance-measurement applicability. Covers all 19 FIRE guide files.

categories.horizontal: Requires plan-view distance measurement — tool CAN measure
categories.vertical-or-mixed: Requires vertical/3D clearance — tool CANNOT fully measure (yet)

subClassifications.distance-only: Distance measurement alone can resolve the verdict (compare measured value to threshold)
subClassifications.distance-plus: Distance measurement needed but verdict also requires additional information (see additionalRequirements)

additionalRequirementTypes.surface-type-verification: Surface material type must be verified (asphalt, concrete, alternative/grass paver, etc.)
additionalRequirementTypes.obstruction-identification: Obstructions must be identified and accounted for (dumpsters, parking, landscaping, equipment)
additionalRequirementTypes.sprinkler-status-verification: Sprinkler system presence and type must be verified (NFPA 13, 13R, 13D)
additionalRequirementTypes.building-height-verification: Building height or story count must be verified for aerial apparatus determination
additionalRequirementTypes.gate-specification: Gate type, mechanism, and emergency operation must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.load-rating-verification: Structural load capacity (HS-20) must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.easement-verification: Legal easement or agreement (JUAE/UDA) must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.occupancy-classification: Building occupancy classification must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.construction-type-verification: Building construction type per IBC must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.wui-zone-verification: Wildland Urban Interface proximity zone must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.pipeline-identification: Hazardous pipeline presence and designation must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.combustibility-verification: Combustible vs non-combustible construction must be determined
additionalRequirementTypes.hydrant-type-verification: Public vs private hydrant status must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.fence-height-verification: Fence or wall height must be verified (4+ feet creates obstruction)
